title: fix: generate monthly diary once
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Runs the monthly website diary only on the first day of each month
- Keeps manual monthly generation available for recovery
- Leaves daily, weekly, Buffer, Discord, and Reddit behavior unchanged

gist.headline: One moon, one diary
gist.blurb: The monthly diary has learned the calendar. It now blooms once on the first day of each month, while the manual watering can remains close at hand.
gist.summary: Updated the news summary workflow so the monthly website diary generates only on the first day of each month, while manual monthly runs remain available for recovery.
gist.impact: Diary readers get one clean monthly recap instead of repeat entries, with daily, weekly, Buffer, Discord, and Reddit schedules unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy calendar garden represents the scheduling fix: Polli carefully circles the first day of a pixel month while a single diary flower blooms beside it. A small retro terminal and a manual watering can show that automated monthly publishing is precise but recovery runs are still possible.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: 'ONCE A MONTH'.
